_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Laundry and Fabric-Contact Home Products Program Manual for Category 19. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.laundry-and-fabric-contact-home-products is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 19 Program Manual. Thirteen live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on the program retest schedule. Metal safety only.
